reason: I write everything by hand and I don't hand client voice to an AI. Another subscription on top of my scheduler, and it doesn't even publish, so I'd still be copy-pasting.
objection: My clients pay me for my own writing. If it sounds like AI, I lose them, and saving a tone profile once won't make me trust it with their brand.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing real output in a client's voice that I couldn't tell from my own writing, plus approvals and publishing built in so it replaces something I already pay for.
